scenes.say: One weekend, two races, and they're nothing alike. Meet E-Prix Unleashed.
Per the FIA description, the new race runs about twenty-five minutes. A classic Formula E race takes about forty.
The short race uses high downforce. The classic uses low, less drag and easier energy saving.
In Unleashed, Attack Mode lasts six minutes. Expect wheel-to-wheel fights.
The mandatory Pit Boost stop stays in the classic race. The short one has none.
Short races only run at double-headers, and there are eight of them this season.
Twenty-one races in thirteen cities. Mexico City opens it on January sixteenth, and Jeddah moved to April.
Race points haven't changed: twenty-five for the winner, and points for the top ten.
The Formula E calendar is on LapRadar.

title: E-Prix Unleashed: the short Formula E race that did not exist before
